text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The local election law is to be changed, probably next week, the paper learns.
- Winter electricity tariff to be applied from October 1, the government decided at its session yesterday.
- The economy is suffocating under the weight of losses and debts despite positive trends in production - commentary.
- Ohrid to host a medical experts' congress on latest achievements in gastroenterology and hepatology.
- Over 21 percent of Macedonia's workers have not received their July wages, the department of statistics reported.
- Workers of agricultural industrial combine VINOJUG resume strike.
- Strike of over 400 workers of Protex in Probistip continues.
